name: What are common challenges in framing a small addition?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges in framing a small addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in framing a small addition include ensuring the new structure integrates seamlessly with the existing home, especially concerning rooflines and foundation tie-ins. Dealing with unforeseen conditions in older homes, such as uneven existing walls or outdated electrical/plumbing, can also pose difficulties. Adhering to strict local building codes and navigating tight property lines in urban areas like the Bay Area are also frequent hurdles that require careful planning and experienced craftsmanship to overcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges in framing a small addition include integrating with the existing home, dealing with unforeseen conditions, and adhering to strict local building codes.
